mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low UNRATE periods (UNRATE < 5.0%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% indicates a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market expansion that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase) fails to produce positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle contraction regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity and impending recession, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline in late-cycle contraction does not produce negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) within the 2-3% inflation range indicates a healthy economy with rising demand, supporting corporate pricing power and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in moderate inflation periods (CPIAUCSL 2-3% above base) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units indicate a weakening housing sector, which reduces consumer wealth and construction activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a contraction in consumer demand amid monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (RSAFS decline and FEDFUNDS rise) fails to produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS increase during monetary tightening cycles does not produce negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
